args.sql:
WITH health_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        de.distregistry AS registry_id,
        (
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN eah.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0
                    WHEN eah.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Limited' THEN 0.6
                    WHEN eah.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Critical' THEN 0.3
                    ELSE 0.0
                END
            ) * (
                CASE 
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) * (
                1 - (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                        ELSE 0
                    END / 6.0
                )
            )
        ) AS health_resilience_score
    FROM 
        disasterevents de
    JOIN 
        environmentandhealth eah ON de.distregistry = eah.envdistref
),
health_crisis AS (
    SELECT 
        hs.registry_id,
        hs.health_resilience_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN eah.diseaserisk = 'High' 
            AND eah.waterqualityindex < 50 
            AND hs.health_resilience_score < 40 THEN 'Health Crisis'
            ELSE 'Normal Health Status'
        END AS health_status
    FROM 
        health_scores hs
    JOIN 
        environmentandhealth eah ON hs.registry_id = eah.envdistref
)
SELECT 
    registry_id, health_resilience_score, health_status
FROM 
    health_crisis
ORDER BY 
    health_resilience_score;

events.sql:
WITH health_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        de.distregistry AS registry_id,
        (
            (
                CASE 
                    WHEN eah.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Adequate' THEN 1.0
                    WHEN eah.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Limited' THEN 0.6
                    WHEN eah.medicalemergencycapacity = 'Critical' THEN 0.3
                    ELSE 0.0
                END
            ) * (
                CASE 
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                    WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) * (
                1 - (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 1' THEN 1
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 2' THEN 2
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 3' THEN 3
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 4' THEN 4
                        WHEN de.hazlevel = 'Level 5' THEN 5
                        ELSE 0
                    END / 6.0
                )
            )
        ) AS health_resilience_score
    FROM 
        disasterevents de
    JOIN 
        environmentandhealth eah ON de.distregistry = eah.envdistref
),
health_crisis AS (
    SELECT 
        hs.registry_id,
        hs.health_resilience_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN eah.diseaserisk = 'High' 
            AND eah.waterqualityindex < 50 
            AND hs.health_resilience_score < 40 THEN 'Health Crisis'
            ELSE 'Normal Health Status'
        END AS health_status
    FROM 
        health_scores hs
    JOIN 
        environmentandhealth eah ON hs.registry_id = eah.envdistref
)
SELECT 
    registry_id, health_resilience_score, health_status
FROM 
    health_crisis
ORDER BY 
    health_resilience_score;
